consumer_demand.label: Consumer demand strength
consumer_demand.event_context: July 2023 advance retail sales +0.7% m/m vs +0.4% consensus (released 2023-08-15 08:30 EDT). Documents published before the release are economic CONTEXT, not reactions to this surprise.

forward_earnings_expectations.label: Forward earnings / revenue expectations and guidance
forward_earnings_expectations.replaces_v1_node: earnings_expectations (v1 label 'Expected corporate earnings / revenues', which let realised revenue count)

edge.condition: Holds when firms translate stronger consumer demand into improved forward earnings/revenue guidance or outlook, without an offsetting mechanism (e.g. margin compression from input costs, wages, discounting or mix shift).
edge.retrieval_question: Do companies explicitly attribute raised, lowered or maintained forward earnings or revenue guidance or outlook to the strength of consumer demand?
edge.retrieval_query: guidance outlook raised full-year expects forecast consumer demand spending strength resilient customers traffic expect sales earnings

criteria.supported: At least one quote explicitly attributes an IMPROVED forward earnings/revenue guidance or outlook to STRONGER consumer demand (attribution and outlook change stated in the source itself, not inferred).
criteria.contradicted: At least one quote explicitly shows stronger consumer demand FAILING to improve forward expectations, AND a quote states the offsetting mechanism (e.g. margin compression, costs, discounting, mix).
criteria.insufficient_evidence: Everything else, including: historical/realised sales or revenue growth alone; growth attributed to strategy, pricing or unstated causes; unchanged or reaffirmed guidance without an explicit demand link; weak demand accompanied by weak results (consistent with, not contrary to, the link); general economic outlook without an earnings link.
